Title: Azure Event Grid support for System Assigned Managed Identities is now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Event Grid now supports system assigned managed identities. Use system assigned identities to manage the publishing of events to your other Azure resources.

For example, assign a topic the ”Azure Event Hubs data sender” role to authorize event subscriptions from that topic to publish to an Event Hubs endpoint.

Learn more in the documentation
